name: Bug report
about: A skill or doc isn't working as described

**What's wrong**
A clear description of the problem.

**Which skill / doc**
e.g. `lynqu-lead-capture`, or `docs/mcp/connect.md`.

**Client + version**
e.g. Claude Desktop 1.x, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code.

**MCP server URL used**
`https://api.lynqu.com/mcp/v2` or `/mcp/me`.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. …
2. …

**Exact error**
Paste the verbatim error. If a tool call failed, include the tool name. You can
paste `who-am-i` output (auth context only — no secrets).

> Check `docs/mcp/troubleshooting.md` first — many connection issues are covered
> there.
